question: Can we create a credit note in the system, and which month of 2025 had our highest invoiced revenue in TZS?
reason: The document part is right; the record part is refused member_not_found. The planner request carries the whole mixed question (D-COMPOUND) plus 'Suggested reading: Which month of 2025 had our highest invoiced revenue in TZS?'; the planner refuses because 'credit note' has no member, although search_documents already answered that part. The same month question alone answers December 2025 (RS1, gran-month 3/3).
